correctness.rationale: The Neumann Green solution is normalized and positive; adding the unique odd homogeneous flux corrector gives endpoint traces and J=kappa(B-beta A)/[1+kappa(1+beta)g] with positive denominator. For a strictly left-supported probability source, d(log B/A)/d eta is strictly negative by comparison with the midpoint value of z*tanh(eta*z), and its limits are 1 and 0; reflecting the source gives strictly increasing ratio 1 to infinity. This proves unique/nonexistent zeros, both signs, and nonzero derivative at the root for all admissible real parameters. Uniform-half-source integration gives exact arcosh threshold, weak-bias limit follows from Taylor expansion. 877 numerical checks include an independent finite-volume elliptic solution with mesh convergence; numerical tests are auxiliary, not proof.

value.rationale: Directionally biased permeable interfaces and spatial resetting are two physically motivated competing mechanisms for transport on a closed ring. The theorem determines exactly when increasing reset frequency reverses stationary membrane circulation for every one-sided (even atomic/singular) source, with no tuning of permeability; a closed uniform-source threshold and universal local mean-based weak-bias law make the sharp boundary observable. The exact permeability-independent phase diagram and strict uniqueness are not a trivial normalization check, arbitrary parameter substitution, or known-table recomputation.
